_meta.palette_discipline: volt single-accent (HSV H 24-48, S>90, V>60) + white/ink; invert frames = monochrome negative + volt-negative ONLY
_meta.usage: recipe = ordered ops executed by the preset renderer (Phase 32 F7); every op maps to banked components (v22kit/ig24kit/wc25kit/renderlib/histmap_kit)

prompts.gate: B9 ratio<=0.92 + OCR full word + clearance>=8
